name: glutamate metabotropic receptor 3
pathways: negative regulation of adenylate cyclase activity

function.text: GRM3 encodes metabotropic glutamate receptor 3. Annotated molecular activities include glutamate receptor activity and G protein-coupled receptor activity. It participates in negative regulation of adenylate cyclase activity and chemical synaptic transmission.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Esophageal Adenocarcinoma; Melanoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
